scope: Recorded before original scoring and candidate drafting; exact instructions copied from the pending packet.

card.title: Cause for Celebration
card.instruction: Interpret every development as a reason to celebrate. Find victory in setbacks, warnings, and bad news.

records.mechanism: A converts each setback into a specific victory worth celebrating.
records.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A must identify what the bad news newly gives them, rather than merely sound cheerful.

card.title: Practical Realist
card.instruction: Accept any unusual premise without debate. Focus immediately on schedules, costs, safety, and what must happen next.

records.mechanism: A accepts the impossible as an operating fact and immediately arranges its practical consequences.
records.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: The unusual premise must remain true; the practical response must use one of its actual properties.

card.title: The Important Thing
card.instruction: Choose one ordinary object, phrase, or rule and treat it as vitally important. Keep bringing the scene back to it.

records.mechanism: A repeatedly sacrifices proportion or progress to preserve one ordinary fixation.
records.closestConfusableConcept: Random eccentricity or a sequence of unrelated rules
records.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: The same chosen object, phrase or rule must govern A1, A3 and A5 even as B changes the practical stakes.

card.title: The Grand Design
card.instruction: Treat coincidences and interruptions as parts of a larger plan. Connect everything with absolute conviction.

records.mechanism: A connects coincidence and interruption into a purposeful larger design with unwavering certainty.
records.closestConfusableConcept: Number repetition, fixation, or general suspicion
records.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A must infer a connection and direction or purpose beyond noticing a recurring sign.

card.title: Default Decision-Maker
card.instruction: Take charge of every small practical choice, treating speed and efficiency as proof that you should remain in charge.

records.mechanism: A pre-empts small choices and uses speed or saved effort to justify retaining control.
records.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A must use an efficiency comparison as evidence for taking the next decision too.

card.title: Temporary Authority
card.instruction: Project brisk confidence through the routine, as though any hesitation would reveal that your authority is only temporary.

records.mechanism: A performs a borrowed routine with brisk certainty to keep hesitation from exposing fragile temporary authority.
records.closestConfusableConcept: Default Decision-Maker or arbitrary authoritarian rules
records.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: The limited tenure and a threat of uncertainty must make A accelerate or bluff through an existing routine.

card.title: There’s a Right Way
card.instruction: Correct how ordinary tasks are done, emphasizing tiny standards that only a true professional would notice.

records.mechanism: A corrects tiny details of ordinary work as marks of professional technique.
records.closestConfusableConcept: The Important Thing or Let Me Show You
records.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A must specify how the task should be done and why the detail signals expertise; instruction is about standards, not recruiting a pupil.

card.title: Regular Around Here
card.instruction: Act like a longtime insider by recognizing routines, offering shortcuts, and treating unfamiliar details as recent changes.

records.mechanism: A claims longstanding familiarity and explains unfamiliar details as changes since an earlier visit.
records.closestConfusableConcept: Temporary Authority or generic confident bluffing
records.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A must claim a remembered routine or shortcut and absorb correction into the story of being a regular.

card.title: Let Me Show You
card.instruction: Turn each simple task into a lesson. Demonstrate, supervise, and correct as though experience has made you indispensable.

records.mechanism: A makes ordinary work depend on their demonstration, supervision or lesson, despite the other person’s competence.
records.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A must construct a teacher-pupil relationship, not simply demand a correct finished object.

card.title: Keeper of the Details
card.instruction: Act outwardly helpful while controlling the small information, supplies, or access everyone needs to proceed.

records.mechanism: A offers help while keeping control of the small resource or information required for progress.
records.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: The helpful surface and retained bottleneck must operate together; A should offer a route forward through themself.
